{{Top|leg}}
'''Xenosociologists'''<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>, also known as '''sociologists''',<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref> studied [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their culture. The field of study was known as [[xenosociology]].<ref name="Secrets" /> 

Xenosociologists endeavoured to introduce "civilization" to the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. All attempts to do so met with disaster.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> However, xenosociologists studying the Gamorreans noted that several large [[clan-town]]s had begun to sub-divide into [[sub-clan]]s while still considering themselves part of the same overall clan. Debates in xenosociological circles wondered if this development heralded potential change within Gamorrean society or if the towns were destined to collapse in on themselves due to population and social pressures.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets}}</ref>

Xenosociologists studying the [[Stenax]] in the aftermath of the [[Stenax Massacres]] noted that large numbers of them settled on [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] and [[Kulthis]]. They avoided contact with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers and it was unknown why they were interested in those worlds. Given the behavior of the Stenax, the sociologists warned that a repeat of the Stenax Massacres was a possibility.<ref name="Marvel" />

A xenosociologist working for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] rediscovered the [[Eol Sha Colony|colony]] on [[Eol Sha]]. The sociologist submitted a report that recommended the colony's immediate evacuation from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] due its tandem moon that would eventually collide with Eol Sha and destroy it. The report also contained mention of one of the original [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], a woman named [[Ta'ania]], who was an illegitimate descendant of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and the current leader of the colonists, a man named [[Gantoris]] who had the uncanny ability to sense [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. The sociologist's report was enough for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to suspect Gantoris was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and a potential recruit for his fledging [[Jedi Praxeum]].<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>
